title: Class 2, Stage A Cemental Tear Mimicking Apical Periodontitis: A Case Report
html: A cemental tear is a rare condition that can closely mimic endodontic and periodontal diseases, making accurate diagnosis challenging. Early identification is essential to ensure appropriate treatment and to avoid unnecessary or ineffective interventions.A 75-year-old woman presented with discomfort and a sinus tract associated with the mandibular right lateral incisor (tooth 42 (Universal #26)). Clinical examination showed no periodontal pocket, and conventional periapical radiographs showed a periapical radiolucency.
